about_the_game:
Hook, Fight, and Reel!

A hidden giant lurks below, waiting for its next challenger. The moment you hook it, the battle begins! Feel the tension as the line tightens, the struggle as you reel it in, and the rush of victory when you land the legendary catch. Are you ready for the fight of your life?

100+ epic fish & Legendary gear

Common fish? Been there, done that! Now it's time for the real deal to catch massive groupers, albino beasts, and deep-sea giants. Upgrade your own rod, power up the reel, and get ready to land the biggest catch of your life!

All aboard for an epic fishing journey

Hop aboard your dream boat and explore the world’s greatest fishing spots! From the crystal-clear waters of Southeast Asia to the mysterious Indian Ocean, the vast Atlantic, and the rich fishing grounds of North and South America—an unforgettable journey awaits. Conquer the waves and reel in legendary catches from around the world!

Endless excitement, your own fishing legacy

🎮 Freestyle Mode – Cast your line and relax in solo fishing

🏆 Solo Match – Compete against anglers from around the world

🤝 Team Match – Team up and experience the thrill of co-op fishing

Compete, cooperate, and create unforgettable moments in various game modes!

Discover rare species, expand your fish collection, and design an awesome aquarium filled with stunning creatures!

Express yourself with unique customization

Fishing is more than just skill—it’s style! Mix and match different outfits and gear to create a look that’s all your own. Sporty, flashy, or totally wild—the ocean is your runway!
